meaning.zh:
“大人物” 或 “重要人物”。

这个短语 “bigwig” 的起源可以追溯到18世纪。当时，佩戴假发在欧洲的贵族和上层社会中十分流行，而假发的尺寸和形状往往象征着地位的高低。那些头戴大假发的人通常是社会地位很高的重要人物。因此，“bigwig” 逐渐演变成了对重要人物、权贵的俗称。
meaning.en: The origin of the term "bigwig" can be traced back to the 18th century when wearing wigs was popular among European nobility and the upper classes. The size and shape of the wig often symbolized one's status. Those with big wigs were generally high-status individuals. Hence, "bigwig" evolved to colloquially refer to someone of importance or authority.

lines.en: The CEO and other *bigwigs* will be attending the meeting tomorrow.
lines.zh: 首席执行官和其他大人物们将参加明天的会议。

lines.en: He became a *bigwig* in the tech industry after his startup was acquired.
lines.zh: 他的初创公司被收购后，他成了科技行业的大人物。

lines.en: We need a *bigwig* to endorse our new product to get media attention.
lines.zh: 我们需要一个大人物来为我们的新产品背书，以吸引媒体的关注。
